why: Takes the scroller back off the Main Menu/pause panel, Records, Customize and Achievements. Those panes are `position: absolute; inset: 0` inside a fixed HUD, so without it their overflow is simply cut off. Measured in Chromium, the 44 px floor alone pushed 11 control readings off them that were reachable before it -- five Customize accent swatches at 320x568 among them -- and this change brought that to 0.
killedBy: hud.css is syntactically whole never centres the main axis of a pane that scrolls
